title: Russian Strikes Hit Two Major Bridges in Kyiv, Mayor Says
detail: Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko said Russian strikes hit two important bridges in the capital, with explosions reported hours after Trump said Putin was 'backing down'. Only the live-blog headline was available; damage and casualties are not established.

title: Zelensky: 55% of Russian Oil Refining Offline After Ukrainian Strikes
detail: Zelensky says 55 percent of Russia's oil refining capacity is offline after Ukrainian strikes, following Trump telling Ukraine to stop the strikes. Figure is a Ukrainian government claim and not independently verified.

title: Russian Airstrikes on Ukrainian Aid Hub Reportedly Kill 72; Rescue Site Struck Nine More Times
detail: UNITED24 Media reports Russian airstrikes on a Ukrainian aid hub killed 72 people, with the rescue site struck nine more times. Only the headline summary was available; location and casualty figures are not independently verified.
